description_en: Queries the list of distributed products
description_zh: 调用该接口查询已分发的产品列表
name: ListDistributedProduct

parameters.help_en: The number of products to display per page. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的产品数量。最大不超过200条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance to which the product belongs.

Public instance IDs for each region:

    - China (Shanghai): iotx-oxssharez200.
    - Japan: iotx-oxssharez300.
    - Singapore: iotx-oxssharez400.
    - US (Silicon Valley): iotx-oxssharez500.
    - US (Virginia): iotx-oxssharez600.
    - Germany (Frankfurt): iotx-oxssharez700.

Steps to view the instance ID of an Enterprise instance:
    
    1. Log on to the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/) and select a region from the drop-down menu in the upper-left corner of the top navigation bar.
    
    2. On the Overview page, find the target instance and view the ID
parameters.help_zh:
产品所属的源实例ID。

各地域公共实例ID：

    - 华东2（上海）：iotx-oxssharez200。
    - 日本：iotx-oxssharez300。
    - 新加坡：iotx-oxssharez400。
    - 美国（硅谷）：iotx-oxssharez500。
    - 美国（弗吉尼亚）：iotx-oxssharez600。
    - 德国（法兰克福）：iotx-oxssharez700。

查看企业版实例ID的步骤：
    
    1. 登录物联网平台控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/)，从顶部导航栏左上方的下拉菜单选择地域。
    
    2. 在实例概览页面，找到目标实例，查看ID
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target instance to which the product is distributed. For more information about instance IDs, see the description of the SourceInstanceId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 产品分发的目标实例ID。实例ID详情，请参见参数SourceInstanceId描述
parameters.name: target_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the product belongs. Log on to the IoT Platform console, click the profile picture, and navigate to the Basic Information page to view the Account ID
parameters.help_zh: 产品所属的阿里云账号ID。可登录物联网平台控制台，单击账号头像，跳转至基本信息页面查看账号ID
parameters.name: target_uid

parameters.help_en: The page number to start displaying results from. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值是1
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The product list returned if the call is successful. For more information, see the Info parameter
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的产品列表，详情请参见Info下信息

Total.description_en: The total number of products returned

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
